question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating on that reality in every place?
premises: Meditation is performed in place after place
That reality is the object of meditation
Its range extends from Śiva down to Avīci
inference: One should meditate on that reality in every place as pervading all levels from Śiva to Avīci.
plain_english: Having meditated on that in place after place, as extending from Śiva down to Avīci,
